lines.text: Tell them about the jukebox.
No.
He put in a coin, it played the wrong song, and he apologised to it. For ten minutes.
It was trying its best, Rook.
First job. Rook says 'I'll handle the guard.'
I did handle the guard.
You handed me the guard.
Delegation. It's a leadership skill.
She came in with a rivet through her hand and asked if it was 'a whole thing'.
It wasn't a whole thing. I clocked back in after.
That's the problem, Mags.
I wrote our whole exit route on a napkin.
And then?
And then I needed a napkin.
He holds the bandages for me. Every time.
Somebody should be gentle in this crew.
He means him. He's the gentle one. He also broke a door with his face last week.
Every camera on the floor has a blind spot. I know all of them.
I know all the ones in the code. Together we're basically invisible.
Together we're basically a fire hazard.
Fifteen years on that line, Rook. You walked in with a plan on a beer mat.
And?
And it's the first plan in fifteen years that wasn't theirs.
